# Preface {.unnumbered}

<!--
The university's PhD regulations (§ 10-1) require that the supervisors are
named in the preface. For an article-based dissertation the preface is written
in the same language as the synthesis ("kappe").
-->

The work presented in this dissertation was carried out at the Department of
Public Health and Sport Sciences, Faculty of Health and Social Sciences,
University of Inland Norway, between 2022 and 2026. It was funded by the
university's PhD programme in Health and Welfare.

My main supervisor has been Professor Kari Nordmann, University of Inland
Norway, and my co-supervisor Associate Professor Erik Hansen, Norwegian School
of Sport Sciences. I am grateful to both for their patience and for reading
more drafts than anyone reasonably should. Thanks also to the participants, who
turned up at seven in the morning through two Innlandet winters.

Any remaining errors are my own.

Lillehammer, May 2026\
Ola Nordmann
